name: A_REEL_COMPOSE
description: LLM-first reel composer foundation (P1): brief → seed → walk → clip-boundaries; emits a ComposedPlan.

store.description: Named ZkStore identity. Defaults from ZK_STORE_NAME, then 'default'.

corpus_root.description: Shared source-video corpus root; never derived from store identity.

compose_mode.description: deterministic (default; graph-walk + perspective-aware dedup) or zk-native (single LLM-driven compose call). On zk-native failure runCompose transparently falls back to deterministic and surfaces a warning.

out.description: Plan JSON output path. Default: out/composed-plans/<ISO-timestamp>.json

plan_path.description: Absolute path to the written ComposedPlan JSON

clarify.description: Present iff status='clarify'; mirrors ClarifyOutput {rephrased_briefs, weak_match_cards, question}

preview_path.description: PV-5 (slice 8): absolute path to the preview MP4 emitted by runCompose's post-Step-7 preview pass. Absent when --no-preview was passed, when status is fail/clarify, or when PREVIEW_FFMPEG_FAILED was caught as warning.

notes: Exit codes: 0 on pass/warn/clarify (non-strict); 2 on fail (incl. unmatched cards without best_effort); 3 on clarify when strict_seed=true; 1 on UNHANDLED (no parseable last-line JSON — A_REEL_COMPOSE must NOT attempt to parse stdout on exit 1). COSMIC_PROJECT_ROOT (P3 CR-6/CR-8): when set by the parent, the CLI auto-resolves projectRoot and writes media (videos + reels) under <projectRoot>/media/; the child process inherits this variable from the parent env (Bun.spawn default) — no Input field is required. When unset, the CLI falls back to JSONL discovery and may exit 2 with PROJECT_ROOT_UNRESOLVED.
